slides.title: Day 1. It's chimney season and you're the only one who knows where the insurance certificate lives.

slides.label: Day 2.
slides.title: Every homeowner wants a sweep before Thanksgiving.
slides.body: The schedule is a whiteboard. The whiteboard is full.

slides.label: Day 4.
slides.title: A property manager asks for your COI.
slides.body: You find two. Both expired last year.

slides.label: Day 6.
slides.title: The new tech starts Monday.
slides.body: His certification card is a photo on his phone. Expiration date: blurry.

slides.label: Day 9.
slides.title: You check the van's registration sticker.
slides.body: It's on the windshield. It's also from last year.

slides.label: Day 11.
slides.title: The business license renewal notice turns up.
slides.body: Under a bag of soot. Postmarked September.

slides.label: Day 12.
slides.title: A car pulls up. It's not a customer.
slides.body: What happens next? Wrong answers only.
